plan.objective: Squared per-player two-minute-bin occupancy error + v49 pair weight .25 times squared whole-game pair overlap error + existing minimumStint/600 per substitution + short-stint shortfall in minutes. All weights fixed before first simulation. Exact five per slot, rounded per-player slots sum480, official starters at first slot. Deterministic quota-preserving rectangle swaps; game RNG unchanged.
plan.scope: Known game minute reconstruction; source profiles exclude entire game fold. No target-game stint sequence, scoring outcome, or player-name overrides. Joint feasibility guarantees apply to the planned grid, not real dead-ball execution or foul-outs.

selection: Earlier-three equal-season normalized phase+pair MAE >1% improvement, each-season regulation minute MAE <=baseline+0.05min and short-share <=baseline+0.01. Select best eligible. Confirm once on disjoint120games/season with same gate; if fail, reject without further tuning on confirmation. Full4season3seed evaluation only after confirmation.
runtime: Current-time plan CDF debt plus 0.5min preference for current planned occupants. Existing eligibility, protection, minimum stint/rest, urgent-minute logic remain. Rest variant also penalizes planned interior rest intervals shorter than source minimumRest.
revision: Correct execution clock alignment: use planned cumulative minutes at current clock, not ordinary minimum-stint lookahead, plus one grid-step occupancy preference. Compare old plan objective with added source minimum-rest shortfall penalty. First probe rejected; no files overwritten.
